lcc_original: 不過有泉源【3】從地裏上來，灌溉【4】地面。
notes: H108 (אֵד): UNV renders as 霧氣 (mist/vapor), LCC renders as 泉源 (spring/fountain) — known exegetical difference for this word (stream vs. mist); both translate H108
H6440 (פָּנִים, face/surface): implicit in UNV as {<WH06440>} but LCC has explicit 面 in 地面; braces dropped per Rule 3 and attached to 面
H3605 (כֹּל, all): UNV expresses as 遍, but LCC has no explicit 'all/entire' equivalent in 地面; kept as implicit {<WAH03605>}
H853 (אֵת, direct object marker): untranslatable particle, no LCC word; kept implicit {<WAH0853>}
